prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Produce ONE whole new county map region TR-35, FIFTH unique region of a5x5 atlas, east-adjacent toTR34. This region explicitly demonstrates the USER'S BLUE CITY BOUNDARY transitioning to nonoperational outer woodland/hills. Native square full-region artwork on opaque plain light-neutral exterior. Not a city carpet, not another civic-center composition.

INPUT1 is the SOURCE-GEOMETRY AND BLUE-BOUNDARY GUIDE, sole authority for roads/buildable footprint positions, existing water body, ground region boundary and fixed orthographic62.5degree elevation/45degree azimuth camera. Renderx[-560.646,136.05], y[-520.242,208.452], approx697m by729m. Match entire region framing and ground scale. The diagram has a narrow western/upper-left strip marked LOW-DENSITY SUBURB and broad eastern/lower-right area marked OUTER FOREST/HILLS. The blue line is semantic boundary x=-361.42, NOT a visible line, fence, road, canal or wall; omit ALL labels, guide colors and lines in final art.
Insideblue x<=-361.42 is about28.6%of this region's source-ground area; outsideblue x>-361.42 inside the red map boundary is about71.4%. There is ZERO green-core/dense urban area in this tile. These are source地面 areas, not literal screen pixel percentages because terrain and building silhouettes rise above ground.
INPUT2 is the USER'S confirmed ORIGINAL Downloads/11/地图效果图.png: sole visual authority for architectural/landscape illustration material quality, painterly daytime light, coherent shadows, diverse modern buildings and natural colors. Do not copy its street map, generic apartment pattern or central landmark package.
INPUT3 is official real Kanazawa City aerial(CC BY4.0): only understand transition between low-rise settlements and natural wooded hills, parcel/roof/massing variation; no photographic texture, haze/sky/horizon/geography/camera or actual Japanese temple/monuments.

SOURCE AND GEOGRAPHIC RULES:
Do not invent roads where the diagram shows forest. The current production guide intentionally omits OUTSIDE-BLUE city-source roads/buildings: their original data is retained but they are NOT authorized development or delivery streets in the outer scenery. Keep the source road geometry and footprints on the suburban side; road end treatments stay inside the city boundary, no new road through the forest to reconnect the city. Preserve the small source pond/stream shape visible inside the natural area; no giant fantasy lake, new river or waterpark. The region's eastern red-map edge is the actual display boundary, do not paint an entire unbounded world, distant skyline, sky or horizon.

SUBURBAN WESTERN STRIP28.6%:
Visibly low-density, mostly1–3storey diverse detached and attached homes with ground side/rear gardens, varied pitched/flat roofs, widths, facade/door rhythms and nonidentical yard organization. Small local shops and ground community garden/play/sitting pockets are scattered within actual buildable parcels. A few larger existing source footprints become LOW low-rise rural-edge clean workshops/service/warehouse or community-use volumes with visibly different roof spans/entrances, no generic mid-rise apartment replacement. Architecture stays insideblue; crossing-blue whole buildings are omitted, not half-cut or moved. No highrise CBD, big mall, grand theater, stadium, science dome, zoo or amusement complex. Do not put housing everywhere to make50%of the full tile: user's approximate50%HOUSING target applies only to the county's PROGRAMMED NEIGHBORHOOD LAND insideblue, not outer natural scenery.
Suburban planted density remains restrained, slightly deeper green, around10%less than earlier urban sample as visual direction; parks/gardens complete and usable. No roof/terrace plants/planters/lawn/green patches.

OUTER NATURAL AREA71.4%:
A coherent designed landscape of broad natural green ground, irregular woodland clusters with differing tree canopy shapes/heights/species, small clearings, rolling wooded slopes and one modest low rocky/tree-covered ridge toward the outer eastern side. Transition naturally from suburban ground gardens to larger woodland without a literal straight wall of trees. Preserve the source pond and small water course with natural banks and nearby reeds/rock/grass as appropriate; no invented huge empty lake. Make the scene rich and finished but not dense generic identical-tree stamps.
This is NATURAL NONOPERATIONAL SCENERY: no housing, business plots, restaurants, civic/visitor-service buildings, tourist facility, observatory, zoo enclosures, lit street grid, delivery roads or pickup markers here. Do not apply the urban10%green-density reduction to clear the forest. Keep hills modest and coherent with the high-angle projection; do not hide the entire suburban strip behind a dramatic mountain. Natural land should remain mostly vegetation/woodland with some exposed rock/ground variation, not flat unfinished empty paving or a manicured city mega-park.

STYLE: same original-user daytime painted architectural city-map language, clean pale masonry/stone/concrete/metal and natural reflective glass for the city strip, deeper natural leaf greens and subtle rock/earth colors for landscape. Coherent sunlight/shadows, no global yellow/amber/orange/sepia or blue tint, glowing windows, facade lights, sunset/night, saturated fantasy colors, photo realism or plastic low-poly render. Ground details differ naturally; no universal orange awnings, cloned white balcony towers or identical tiny fenced-garden kits.
No people, riders, vehicles, UI/text/labels/watermarks/boundary strokes/guide lines. One complete source-ground region, keep full building/tree/terrain silhouettes with safety margin on plain opaque light-neutral background, not transparency/key colors. ONE candidate for individual user review; do not include previous region inset or a collage.
